meta.title: The Amber Tap
meta.premise: Kael runs jobs out of a dockside bar called the Amber Tap, taking whatever the fixer's board turns up and coming home to spend the credits before the next one.

board.title: The Debt to Ruiz
board.pitch: I take the job Tomas asked as a favour, no questions.

board.title: The Quiet Contract
board.pitch: I take the shipment run that pays too well for what it says it is.

board.title: Deck 9 Crate Run
board.pitch: I take the Deck 9 crate run.

opening.title: The Amber Tap
opening.question: What job does Kael take off the board tonight, or why are they still just drinking?
opening.situation: The Amber Tap smells of recycled air and cheap synth-whiskey, its walls papered with job flyers gone soft at the corners. Dessa Korr leans on the bar's far end with a data-slate already scrolling, and Tomas Ruiz keeps pouring without waiting to be asked twice.
opening.secret: Dessa Korr skims a cut off every job she boards before Kael ever sees the offer, and the regular working the corner booth is the only one at the Tap who has noticed.

dessa-korr.name: Dessa Korr
dessa-korr.brief: The fixer who works the Amber Tap's board; she knows every crew on dock and what each of them owes.

tomas-ruiz.name: Tomas Ruiz
tomas-ruiz.brief: Runs the bar and half the favours owed on this dock; he pours first and asks after.

sil-marrow.name: Sil Marrow
sil-marrow.brief: A regular who never takes a job off the board, only watches who does and writes something down.

world.source: A dockside bar, a fixer's board, and whatever job pays the rent this week.
